dataList.description: What is invisible must be coated in color until its outline emerges. Splash enough unseen things with color, и one realizes that one's own body has become stained.

There is a tear that, один раз every long while, is dredged up bloated from the deepest depths. After a long, grueling process of stirring through the rancid stench и the smudging black... the tear regains its original clarity.

The Deep-sea Dye is made from the tears of such olden beings.

Mix the secretion from the Golden Resin with the pus.

Each ounce of the golden is densely saturated with meaning и worth, enough to turn any dye just as aureate. The hard part is getting the secretion.
Woven threads wound for transport. Spin, spin, spin... In every step of its life, the thread spins.
Tears well like yellow pus.
The red, swollen tears burst like a pus-filled abscess.
The blue dye smells of pus.

dataList.description: It's strange that shoes require socks. We wear shoes to protect our feet, yet we place another layer between the foot и the shoe to protect them both? Or... perhaps that excess is what gives socks their dignity. Shoes belong to instinct—we need shoes because our feet hurt without them, while socks fall within the realm of civilization because we want the comfort.
